title: Notion AI + Perplexity: My 3-Tool Stack
caption:
Everyone lies about your tools. Here's the truth.

Unpopular truth about this:
1️⃣ Notion AI — your docs, wiki, and database with AI that answers questions across all of it
2️⃣ Perplexity — answer engine that cites live sources — beats Google for 'what's actually true right now'
3️⃣ Gamma — generates a designed slide deck or one-pager from a prompt
